verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a digital notarization service that documents 'managing signers', so bulk-sending one document to many recipients is a fair question for it. But the evidence only mentions 'B2B bulk notarization' and per-document notarization requests via API. That points to high-volume notarization, not sending the same document to many recipients in one action, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.
